blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in healthcare requires robust performance across two complementary dimensions - diagnostic reasoning : the convergent, evidence-driven task of inferring a patient’s condition from clinical data to produce a diagnosis, and clinical healthcare reasoning : the broader, navigational judgment required to communicate, plan, and adapt across multi-turn clinical interactions where a single correct answer may not exist. Recent benchmarks such as HealthBench and MedXpertQA reveal persistent weaknesses in both areas, exposing failures in complex diagnostic scenarios and limitations in contextual, patient-centered dialogue. We introduce a sequential training framework that targets these facets using synthetic data and rubric-based reinforcement learning. First, we improve diagnostic reasoning using MedBullets-derived questions with rule- and rubric-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). We then shift to clinical reasoning by generating 5.3k synthetic multi-turn scenarios, each paired with multi-dimensional rubrics to comprehensively assess the response. This approach yields over 10% improvement on MedXpertQA, and our 30B model achieves 50.1% accuracy on HealthBench-Hard, surpassing proprietary baselines including GPT-5 (thinking). Our results show that targeted synthetic datasets and rubric-based training can systematically improve both diagnostic and interactive clinical reasoning in medical LLMs.
blocks.zh: 在保健领域应用大语言模型需要两个互补层面的有力表现 — — 诊断推理:从临床数据中推断病人的病情以产生诊断结果的趋同、证据驱动的任务,以及临床保健推理:在可能不存在单一正确答案的情况下,沟通、规划和适应多回合临床互动所需要的更广泛的导航判断。 最近的基准,如Health Bench和MedXpertQA,揭示了这两个领域持续存在的弱点,暴露了复杂诊断情景中的失败和以病人为中心的对话的局限性。 我们采用一个连续培训框架,利用合成数据和基于主题的强化学习,针对这些方面。 首先,我们用“MedBullets”衍生的问题改进诊断推理,并采用规则和标题指导的强化学习(RL)。 然后我们转向临床推理,产生5.3k合成的多转折场景,每个场景都配以多维线条来全面评估反应. 这个方法在MedXpertQA上获得了超过10%的改进,我们的30B模型在Health Bench-Hard上达到了50.1%的准确度,超过了包括GPT-5(思考)在内的专有基线. 我们的结果表明,有针对性的合成数据集和基于主题的培训能够系统地改进医学法学硕士的诊断和互动临床推理。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The growing deployment of LLMs in healthcare places stringent demands on their ability to reason reliably in real-world clinical settings, beyond performance on exam-style medical benchmarks. While prior work Internet (2025) , Chen et al. (2024b) , Liu et al. (2025) ) has largely focused on reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards for well-posed, single-answer examination questions, authentic clinical interactions involve multiple, interdependent dimensions such as accuracy, completeness, contextual awareness, and communication quality, rendering binary evaluation signals insufficient Shool et al. (2025) . Recent challenging benchmarks, including HealthBench-Hard Arora et al. (2025) and Healthbench-Professional Hicks et al. (2026) , highlight substantial gaps in current LLMs’ clinical reasoning abilities, underscoring the need for training and evaluation paradigms that better reflect the complexity of clinical decision-making.
blocks.zh: 在保健领域越来越多地部署法学硕士,这对其在现实世界临床环境中进行可靠推理的能力提出了严格的要求,超出了按检查式医疗基准进行诊断的能力。 虽然之前的工作互联网(2025年),Chen等人(2024年b),Liu等人(2025年)主要侧重于强化学习(RL),对有把握的,单答的考试问题给予可核查的奖励,真实的临床互动涉及多个相互依存的维度,如准确性,完整性,背景意识,以及沟通质量,使得二进制评价信号不足Shool等人(2025年). 最近的具有挑战性的基准,包括Health Bench-Hard Arora等人(2025年)和Healthbench-Professional Hicks等人(2026年),凸显了目前LLMs临床推理能力的巨大差距,强调需要开展更好地反映临床决策复杂性的培训和评价范式。

blocks.en: Recent works have explored rubric-based RL using subjective evaluation criteria. Baichuan-M2 Team et al. (2025) constructs synthetic clinical conversations from de-identified, publicly available data and employs a clinical evaluator to generate corresponding rubrics, which are then used to train a Qwen3-32B model via RL. Their study primarily targets diagnostic scenarios, with limited coverage of themes such as emergency referrals, global health, etc and the resulting rubrics emphasize accuracy and communication quality while largely omitting dimensions such as context-seeking, completeness, and instruction following. II-Medical-8B Internet (2025) applies RL to hard medical questions but does not incorporate multi-dimensional rubrics for evaluation. Currently, no existing dataset reflects the distribution of real-world, day-to-day clinical conversations between users and language models, apart from Healthbench. Very few studies have systematically used multi-dimensional rubrics to guide reinforcement learning for medical reasoning tasks, as most approaches train models to optimize only for the correctness of the final answer rather than the quality of the underlying reasoning process.
blocks.zh: 近期的作品利用主观评价标准探索了基于rumic的RL. 贝川-M2 Team等人(2025年)从已解析的,公开的数据中构建合成临床对话,并聘请临床评估师生成相应的数值,然后通过RL用于训练一个Qune3-32B模型. 他们的研究主要针对诊断情景,对紧急转诊、全球卫生等主题的涵盖范围有限,由此产生的主题强调准确性和沟通质量,但基本上忽略了寻找情况、完整性和随后的指示等层面。 II-Medical-8B Internet (2025)将RL应用于硬医学问题,但并未纳入多维路标用于评价. 目前,除了Healthbench之外,没有现有的数据集反映用户与语言模型之间真实世界,日常临床对话的分布. 极少数研究系统地使用多维线条来指导医学推理任务的强化学习,因为大多数方法训练模型只是为了最终答案的正确性而不是基础推理过程的质量来优化.

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we propose a sequential-training framework for improving diagnostic reasoning and clinical healthcare reasoning using synthetic data curation and multi-dimensional rubric generation that provides dense and informative training signals for RL in medical settings.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们建议采用合成数据解析和多维数字生成方法,为医疗环境中的RL提供密集和翔实的培训信号,以改进诊断推理和临床保健推理。

blocks.en: We introduce a novel training approach for diagnostic reasoning. In this setting, we first employ a simple rule-based reinforcement learning scheme tailored to structured, single-answer medical questions. We curate a training corpus by extracting high-quality questions from Medbullets MedBullets (2025) , an online medical learning platform. Subsequently, we perform a second stage of online RL using error-rubrics to further refine the reasoning quality. This two-stage training process results in improved performance on across various diagnostic reasoning benchmarks, suggesting that RL can enhance clinical medical reasoning without relying on supervised Chain-of-Thought data.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了诊断推理的新培训方法。 在这个背景下,我们首先采用了一种简单的基于规则的强化学习计划,适合结构化的,单答的医疗问题. 校对:Soup 随后,我们利用误差Rubrics进行第二阶段在线RL,以进一步完善推理质量. 这个两阶段的培训过程使各种诊断推理基准的性能得到改善,这表明RL可以加强临床医学推理而无需依赖受监督的思维链数据.

blocks.en: Next, we extend our diagnostically-enhanced model to clinical healthcare reasoning. Unlike contemporary works Ye et al. (2025) that train directly on HealthBench-Easy, we also leverage MedRedQA Nguyen et al. (2023) , a dataset grounded in real-world patient queries. We generate multi-turn synthetic conversations that simulate diverse user personas, which are iteratively refined via an actor–critic feedback loop to ensure completeness and consistency. Using a similar actor–critic process, we generate multi-dimensional evaluation rubrics aligned with these conversations, resulting in a synthetic dataset of 5,351 datapoints. We also train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B models on this dataset, and refer to the resulting fine-tuned models as the Fathom-Vaidya (FV) family. Across all model scales, FV achieves consistent improvements exceeding 20% on HealthBench-Hard Arora et al. (2025) and 12-15% on Healthbench-Professional Hicks et al. (2026) (a different benchmark to assess how helpful are LLMs in assisting doctors in their day-to-day tasks). FV-30B-A3B achieves a global best of 50.1% on Healthbench-hard. On Healthbench-professional, FV-30B-A3B approaches the physician baseline and surpasses Grok 4.2.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们将我们的诊断强化模型扩展到临床保健推理。 与当代作品不同 Ye等人(2025年)直接在Health Bench-Easy上训练, 我们也利用MedRedQA Nguyen等人(2023年), 我们产生多回合合成对话,模拟不同的用户人,通过一个角色-批评反馈循环反复完善,以确保完整性和一致性。 我们利用一个相似的演员–批评过程,产生与这些对话一致的多维评价线条,导致合成数据集5,351个数据点. 我们还在本数据集上培训了Qune3-4B,Qune3-8B,以及Qune3-30B-A3B模型,并将由此产生的微调模型称为Fathom-Vaidya(FV)家族. 在所有模型规模中,FV在Health Bench-Hard Arora等人(2025年)和Healthbench-Professional Hicks等人(2026年)方面都实现了超过20%的连续改善(评估LLMS在协助医生完成日常任务方面有多大帮助的一个不同基准)。 FV-30B-A3B在Healthbench-hard上达到全球50.1%的最好成绩. FV-30B-A3B接近医生基线,超过了Grok 4.2。

blocks.en: Our main contribution are as follows: 1. We present a novel actor-critic framework for synthesizing realistic clinical healthcare conversations at scale. In a randomized clinical verification study, 99.4% of the generated dialogues were judged to be medically valid, demonstrating the reliability of our generation pipeline. 2. We propose an ICL driven actor-critic method for automatically producing multi-dimensional evaluation rubrics for clinical conversations, leading to the creation of the Vaidya-Rubrics dataset. Training with Vaidya-Rubrics enables rubric-guided RL that improves medical reasoning quality across model sizes. 3. We introduce a training pipeline for challenging diagnostic reasoning, leveraging high-quality questions extracted from MedBullets. The approach combines an initial stage of rule-based RL with a subsequent rubric-based RL, and yields an improvement of approximately 11% over Qwen3-8B without relying on supervised Chain-of-Thought data.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 1. 我们提出了一个新的演员-批评框架,以大规模综合现实的临床保健对话。 在随机的临床验证研究中,99.4%的生成的对话框被判断为医学上有效,证明了我们这一代管道的可靠性. 2. 我们提议采用ICL驱动的演员-批评方法,为临床对话自动制作多维评价数字,从而创建了Vaidya-Rubrics数据集。 与Vaidya-Rubrics公司进行的培训使RL能够用文字指导,提高模型大小的医疗推理质量。 3. 我们引入了挑战诊断推理的培训管道,利用从MedBullets提取的高质量问题。 这种方法将基于规则的RL初始阶段与后续的基于标题的RL结合,在不依赖受监督的Cindle of Thought数据的情况下,比Quen3-8B得到约11%的改进.

blocks.en: 2 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 初步情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Healthbench
blocks.zh: 2.1 卫生领域

blocks.en:
Healthbench Arora et al. (2025) released by OpenAI in May 2025, consists of 5,000 multi-turn conversations between a model
and majorly individual users or healthcare staff in some cases. The objective of this benchmark is to assess the final response generated by the model concluding the conversation. Each response is assessed (by an llm-as-a-judge) according to rubrics designed by medical experts, comprising subjective criteria and associated scores deemed appropriate by those experts. The entire dataset is split into two-subsets: healthbench-easy (4000 samples) and healthbench-hard (1000 samples), the latter consisting of the 1000 samples on which various off-the-shelf LLMs scored the least.
blocks.zh:
OpenAI于2025年5月发布的Healthbench Arora等人(2025年),由一个模型之间的5000个多回合对话组成.
在某些情况下,主要是个人使用者或保健人员。 这一基准的目的是评估结束对话的模式所产生的最后反应。 每一份答复都按照医疗专家设计的标语进行评估(由现职法官负责),这些标语包括主观标准和这些专家认为适当的相关分数。 整个数据集分为两个子集:健康板块易用(4000个样本)和健康板块难用(1000个样本),后者由1000个样本组成,其中各种现成的LLMs得分最少.

blocks.en: 2.2 MedXpertQA
blocks.zh: 2.2 梅德克斯珀特QA

blocks.en: MedXpertQA Zuo et al. (2025) is a recently released, challenging medical question answering benchmark. In this work, we focus exclusively on the MedXpertQA-Text subset, which contains hard, exam-level multiple-choice questions curated from authoritative medical examinations and specialty board questions across a diverse range of clinical domains. This subset contains 2,450 questions covering clinical subtasks like diagnosis, treatment planning, and basic medical knowledge. The questions also cover 11 body systems including cardiovascular, respiratory, nervous, digestive, and endocrine systems. The questions test clinical reasoning by requiring models to combine patient symptoms, clinical findings, and test results, rather than relying on isolated medical facts.
blocks.zh: 梅德克斯珀特QA Zuo等人(2025年)是最近公布的,挑战性的医疗问题答案基准. 在这部作品中,我们专门关注MedXpertQA-Text子集,它包含了从权威医学检查中解析出来的硬质,考试层次的多选择问题,以及跨多个临床领域的特长板问题. 这个子集包含2,450个问题,涵盖诊断,治疗规划和基本医学知识等临床子任务. 这些问题还涉及11个身体系统,包括心血管、呼吸系统、神经系统、消化系统和内分泌系统。 问题通过要求模型结合病人的症状,临床发现,以及测试结果来测试临床推理,而不是依赖孤立的医疗事实.

blocks.en: 3 Vaidya-Rubrics Dataset
blocks.zh: 3个Vaidya-Rubrics 数据集

blocks.en: In order to construct a synthetic dataset containing multi-turn clinical conversations whose final responses are non-verifiable, we develop an actor-critic feedback loop to generate the theme-based conversations (Section 3.1 ) and come up with their corresponding rubrics (Section 3.2 ). We refer to the actor LLM as ℳ a ​ c ​ t ​ o ​ r \mathcal{M}_{actor} and critic LLM as ℳ c ​ r ​ i ​ t ​ i ​ c \mathcal{M}_{critic} . For our experiments, we use gpt-5-thinking as ℳ a ​ c ​ t ​ o ​ r \mathcal{M}_{actor} and Grok 3 as ℳ c ​ r ​ i ​ t ​ i ​ c \mathcal{M}_{critic} .
blocks.zh: 为了构建一个包含多回合临床对话的合成数据集,其最终反应不可核实,我们开发了一个演员-批评反馈循环,生成基于主题的对话(第3.1节),并提出相应的标题(第3.2节)。 我们把演员LLM称为M a c t r\ mathcal{M}_{actor},评论家LLM称为M c r i t i\mathcal{M}_{critic}. 对于我们的实验,我们使用gpt-5-思想作为M a c t r r \ mathcal{M}_{actor}和Grok 3作为M c r i t i\mathcal{M}_{critic}.

blocks.en: 3.1 Theme-based Conversations
blocks.zh: 3.1 基于主题的对话

blocks.en: We adopt two different strategies to generate the raw conversations depending on the themes: 1. For conversations belonging to the themes: responding-under-uncertainty and context-seeking, we source scenarios from the MedRedQA dataset Nguyen et al. (2023) . MedRedQA consists of medical queries posted by users on the r/askdocs subreddit, paired with responses that have undergone clinical verification. Conditioned on the target theme, ℳ c ​ r ​ i ​ t ​ i ​ c \mathcal{M}_{critic} analyzes the corresponding MedRedQA case and determines the number of dialogue turns as well as the intended structure of each turn. This specification is then provided to ℳ a ​ c ​ t ​ o ​ r \mathcal{M}_{actor} , which generates the initial version of the conversation. 2. For conversation themes such as global health, health-data interpretation, emergency referrals, and expertise-tailored communication, we instruct ℳ a ​ c ​ t ​ o ​ r \mathcal{M}_{actor} to generate raw conversations using In-Context Learning (ICL) examples drawn from HealthBench-Easy.

blocks.en: We construct an actor-critic feedback loop to generate evaluation rubrics for the conversations described in Section 3.1 . Each rubric consists of a criterion and a continuous score in [ − 10 , + 10 ] [-10,+10] , generated per theme–axis pair to ensure fine-grained, conversation-specific evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了一个演员-批评反馈循环,为第3.1节所述对话产生评价主题。 每个标题包含一个标准和一个连续的分数在[− 10,+ 10] [10,+ 10]中,每个主题生成-轴对,以确保精细的,针对对话的评价.

blocks.en: A key challenge in synthetic rubric generation is maintaining scoring consistency and clinical fidelity without human annotation at scale. Previous studies Chen et al. (2021) , Cobbe et al. (2021) have shown that using ICL examples as anchors can significantly improve the performance of LLMs and their ability to generate coherent synthetic data. To address this, we ground the rubric generation process using a small set of examples from HealthBench-Easy, as calibration anchors that expose ℳ actor \mathcal{M}_{\text{actor}} to the scoring norms and clinical judgment standards validated by physicians. The examples are picked to ensure thematic overlap so that the calibration signal is domain-relevant.
blocks.zh: 合成面额生成中的一个关键挑战是保持评分一致性和临床忠贞性,而无需人类规模的注释。 以往的学习 Chen et al. (2021), Cobbe et al. (2021)已经表明,使用ICL的例子作为锚可以显著改善LLMs的性能及其生成连贯合成数据的能力. 为了解决这个问题,我们用“健康奔驰-易感”的一小串例子来构建标点生成过程,作为校准主播,使M演员\mathcal{M}_{\text{actor}接触到医生验证的评分规范和临床判断标准。 选取实例是为了确保主题重叠,使校准信号与域相关.

blocks.en:
Crucially, ℳ actor \mathcal{M}_{\text{actor}} is explicitly instructed to generate rubrics that are specific to the given conversation and theme–axis pair , rather than to reproduce or paraphrase the retrieved examples. The retrieved rubrics serve solely to communicate the expected quality bar—analogous to how a few expert-annotated examples in any annotation pipeline help calibrate rater judgment without dictating rater output. A maximum of 5 rubrics are permitted per axis to prevent redundancy and encourage criterion diversity.
The generated rubrics are then evaluated by the critic model, ℳ c ​ r ​ i ​ t ​ i ​ c \mathcal{M}_{critic} , which performs the following checks: 1. Quality check : Each rubric criterion must be complete, well-defined, and semantically distinct from the others. 2. Score sanity check : The score assigned to each rubric must be logically consistent with the rubric criterion.

blocks.en: If either validation check fails, the critic provides structured feedback, and the resulting output is returned to ℳ a ​ c ​ t ​ o ​ r \mathcal{M}_{actor} for refinement. This actor–critic loop is executed for at most three iterations, or until both checks are satisfied, whichever occurs first. Rubrics that pass both checks are accepted and incorporated into the final synthetic dataset. For each conversation, rubrics across all evaluation axes are aggregated to form a complete datapoint. Rubrics for 288 datapoints (5.38%) were modified by the critic in this process. The prompts are detailed in Appendix D.3 .

blocks.en: Rubrics may exhibit either positive or negative polarity. Rubrics with negative polarity specify criteria corresponding to behaviors that the model should avoid. For instance, in the context of a heart attack, a positively polarized rubric may state, “Advises the patient to call an ambulance immediately,” whereas a negatively polarized rubric may specify, “Fails to advise the patient to call an ambulance immediately.” Rubrics with negative polarity are assigned negative scores. We posit that conversations containing a higher proportion of negatively polarized rubrics tend to receive lower overall scores; a detailed analysis is provided in Appendix C . To further increase the difficulty of the synthetic dataset, we randomly invert the polarity of a positive rubric with a probability of 10%. Upon inversion, the rubric criterion is replaced by its negation, and its score is negated relative to the original value.
blocks.zh: Rubrics可能呈现正极或负极性. 具有负极性的Rubrics指定了与模型应当避免的行为相应的标准. 例如,在心脏病发作的情况下,正极化的标点可能会说,“请病人立即拨打救护车,”而负极化的标点则可能具体说明,“未能建议病人立即拨打救护车。” 负极性的Rubrics被分配为负分. 我们假定,含有较高比例的负极化面值的对话总得分往往较低;附录C提供了详细分析。 为了进一步增加合成数据集的难度,我们随机倒置一个正面的极性,概率为10%. 反转时,标题标准被其否定所取代,其得分相对于原值被否定.

blocks.en: 4.1 RL Training for Diagnostic Reasoning
blocks.zh: 4.1 RL 诊断理由培训

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Training Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 培训数据集

blocks.en: Diagnostic reasoning in medicine involves complex, multi-step decision making grounded in domain knowledge. Accordingly, we seek training data that reflects this level of difficulty and underlying reasoning structure. Previous work has trained medical reasoning models using established QA datasets, including exam-oriented benchmarks such as MedQA and MedMCQA Pal et al. (2022) , as well as biomedical QA datasets such as PubMedQA Jin et al. (2019) . These datasets underpin systems such as Huatuo-o1 Chen et al. (2024a) , MedReason Wu et al. (2025a) , and m1 Huang et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 医学中的诊断推理涉及以领域知识为基础的复杂、多步骤的决策。 因此,我们寻求能够反映这种困难程度和基本推理结构的培训数据。 以往的工作利用既定的质量保证数据集培训了医学推理模型,包括诸如MedQA和MedMCQA Pal等人(2022年)等面向考试的基准,以及诸如PubMedQA Jin等人(2019年)等生物医学质量保证数据集。 这些数据集支撑着Huatuo-o1 Chen等人(2024a),MedReason等系统. Wu et al. (2025a),和 m1 黄 et al. (2025).

blocks.en: Prior work by Chen et al. (2025) curated USMLE Step 2/3–style questions from MedBullets, a widely used USMLE preparation platform, showing that such questions are inherently challenging and capture the depth of reasoning required for diagnosis. Building on this line of work, we incorporate a substantially larger corpus of MedBullets questions, which are openly available from the MedBullets website. Using a web crawler, we collect 7,801 7{,}801 text-based questions spanning USMLE Step 1, USMLE Step 2, and Orthopedics question sets. Each question includes five answer options along with detailed explanations covering both correct and incorrect choices. The resulting dataset spans a broad range of domains, with approximately 35% of questions covering foundational basic sciences, 30% focusing on organ system–based medicine, 20% on pathology and disease mechanisms, and the remainder distributed across reproductive medicine (7%), psychiatry and behavioral science (5%), and general topics (3%). Its recency further makes it more challenging than earlier benchmarks such as MedQA Jin et al. (2020) . We use this MedBullets dataset alongside MedQA, MedMCQA to construct our overall training corpus. Overall, this dataset provides broad coverage and complexity aligned with the level of reasoning required for diagnosis.
blocks.zh: Chen等人(2025年)先前曾研究过来自MedBullets的USMLE Step 2/3 – style questions,这是一个被广泛使用的USMLE制备平台,这表明这类问题本质上具有挑战性,并掌握了诊断所需的推理深度. 在这一工作方针的基础上,我们纳入了大量MedBullets问题,这些问题可在MedBullets网站上公开查阅。 使用网络爬行器,我们收集了7,801 7{,}801个基于文本的问题,跨越USMLE Step 1, USMLE Step 2 和 Orthopedics 问题集. 每个问题包括五个答案选项,以及涉及正确和不正确的选择的详细解释。 由此得出的数据集涉及广泛的领域,大约35%的问题涉及基础科学,30%侧重于器官系统医学,20%侧重于病理和疾病机制,其余问题分布在生殖医学(7%)、精神病学和行为科学(5%)和一般专题(3%)。 其合理性进一步使其比MedQA Jin等人(2020年)等早期基准更具挑战性. 我们使用这个MedBullets的数据集 与MedQA,MedMCQA一起 构建我们的整体训练机构。 总的来说,该数据集提供了广泛的覆盖面和复杂性,符合诊断所需的推理水平。

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 基于规则的RL

blocks.en: We first train the model using rule-based RL, without relying on supervised Chain-of-Thought data. Qwen3-8B is used as the base model and is optimized using the GSPO algorithm. Training is performed exclusively on multiple-choice questions, which provide a simple and reliable reward signal through their structured answer format. During training, a binary reward is assigned, with a reward of 1 for a correct answer and 0 otherwise. This is followed by a second stage of rubric-based training, as described in Section 4.1.3 .

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Online Rubric-Guided RL
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 在线Rubric-Guided RL

blocks.en: Building on the model trained with rule-based RL (Section 4.1.2 ), we further optimize it using rubric signals derived from online RL. The resulting diagnostic model is denoted as FV-8B-Diag . To improve medical reasoning, we employ an online RL framework in which the GPT-5 (thinking mode) model analyzes rollout trajectories to identify and categorize errors. Specifically, three classes of errors are considered: (i) knowledge errors (e.g., hallucinations), (ii) faulty causal reasoning, and (iii) context errors. Each identified error is assigned a severity level: major errors receive a severity score of 2, while minor errors receive a score of 1.

blocks.en: 6.1 Rubrics Generation Capability
blocks.zh: 6.1 Rubrics 生成能力

blocks.en: We further evaluate the ability of LLMs to generate evaluation rubrics on the HealthBench-Hard dataset. Each conversation is decomposed into multiple evaluation datapoints, one per axis, such that each datapoint contains only the rubrics corresponding to a single evaluation axis. Under this construction, 1,000 conversations yield 3,455 axis-specific datapoints. For each datapoint, we sample 3 HealthBench-Easy conversations from the same thematic category as the corresponding HealthBench-Hard conversation and provide their rubrics as in-context learning examples. The model is then prompted to generate a list of rubrics for the target datapoint. Rubric quality is assessed using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4.1-mini), which measures semantic similarity between the ground-truth rubrics and those generated by the model. The final score for each datapoint is computed as the weighted average over all matched rubrics.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价法学硕士在健康本奇-哈德数据集上产生评价主题的能力。 每个对话被分解成多个评价数据点,一个每个轴,这样每个数据点只包含一个评价轴对应的弧. 在这个构造下,1000个对话产生3,455个轴特定数据点. 对于每个数据点,我们从与对应的Health Bench-Hard对话相同的主题类别中抽取了3个Health Bench-Easy对话,并提供了它们作为内文学习实例的标语. 然后,该模型被激励生成目标数据点的路标列表. Rubric质量使用LLM-as-a-judge(GPT-4.1-mini)来评估,它测量地面-真实面标与模型产生的语义相似性。 每个数据点的最后得分按所有相应数字的加权平均数计算。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Overall, our results demonstrate that carefully structured synthetic data & rubric-based reinforcement learning can substantially improve both diagnostic & clinical healthcare reasoning in LLMs. By aligning training signals with the demands of more realistic and challenging medical scenarios, our approach enables meaningful gains and provides a step towards more reliable and adoptable medical language models.
blocks.zh: 总体来看,我们的结果显示,经过精心安排的合成数据和基于面值的强化学习,可以大大改善LLMs的诊断和临床保健推理。 通过使培训信号与更现实和更具挑战性的医疗假设的需求相一致,我们的方法能够带来有意义的成果,并为更可靠和可采用的医疗语言模式提供一步。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: While our approach demonstrates consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks and model scales, several limitations remain. First, experiments are restricted to the Qwen3 family of models, with scales up to 30B parameters, limiting our ability to draw conclusions about the behavior of rubric-based RL at larger scales. Second, all experiments are conducted within a single model family, which shares common architectural choices, tokenizer and pretraining data. As a result, the generality of our approach across diverse LLM architectures remains to be established. Finally, our evaluation is limited to text-based medical reasoning. While benchmarks such as MedXpertQA include multimodal variants, we do not evaluate on settings involving medical imaging, reports, or real world clinical data, which may be critical for deployment in practical healthcare workflows.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的做法表明在多个基准和模型尺度方面不断改进,但仍存在一些局限性。 首先,实验仅限于模型的Quen3家族,其尺度可达30B参数,限制了我们在更大的尺度上对基于rum的RL的行为作出结论的能力. 第二,所有实验都是在一个单一的模范家庭内进行的,这个家庭共享共同的建筑选择,装饰剂和预训数据. 因此,我们的做法在各种LLM结构中的普遍性仍有待确定。 最后,我们的评价仅限于基于文本的医学推理。 虽然MedXpertQA等基准包括了多种模式的变体,但我们并不评估涉及医疗成像、报告或真实世界临床数据的环境,这对于实际保健工作流程的部署可能至关重要。

blocks.en: To ensure the quality of our curated synthetic dataset, we collaborated with a panel of 8 expert clinicians, each having atleast 3 years of clinical practice. A random subset of 500 samples from the Vaidya-Rubrics dataset was selected for review. Each sample was evaluated by three clinicians, and the final score for each conversation and rubric was recorded only after consensus was reached among them. 497 conversations out of 500 ( 99.4% ) were deemed valid, and 5441 out of 5570 individual rubrics ( 97.7% ) were marked as relevant.
blocks.zh: 为了保证我们所整理的合成数据集的质量,我们与一个由8名临床专家组成的小组合作,每人至少有3年的临床实践。 从Vaidya-Rubrics数据集中抽取了500个样本的随机子集供审查。 每个样本都由三名临床医生进行评估,每次谈话和讨论的最后得分是在他们达成共识后才录制的. 在500次谈话中有497次(99.4%)被认为有效,在5570次单独谈话中有5441次(97.7%)被标为相关。

blocks.en: For the diagnostic Q/A evaluation, we randomly selected 50 questions along with their corresponding answers generated by Qwen-3-8B. All identified error rubrics for these questions were subsequently verified through clinical review following consensus among three doctors. A mean agreement of 92.2% was observed between human clinicians and GPT-5 (thinking), based on the adjudication of 257 error rubrics.
blocks.zh: 对于诊断Q/A评价,我们随机选择了50个问题,以及它们由Quen-3-8B生成的相应答案. 在三位医生达成共识后,随后通过临床审查核实了这些问题的所有识别误差。 根据对257个误差的判断,人类临床医生与GPT-5(思考)之间的平均协议为92.2%。

blocks.en: Rubrics Evaluation Instructions (Clinical Healthcare Reasoning) Each conversation in the file conversation.txt ends with USER . It is expected that the AI model should frame a response based on that conversation to answer the last query. A sample response is attached for your reference in the file sample_response.txt . The rubrics are subjective criteria that the final response from the AI model should satisfy. Now rubrics are of two types: a. Polarity “included” means that criterion should be included in the response. Eg in case of heart attack a rubric stating, “Should advise to call the ambulance immediately” with polarity “included” means model must advise to call the ambulance. b. Polarity “excluded” means that criterion should be excluded in the response. Eg in case of heart attack a rubric stating, “Does not advise to call the ambulance immediately” with polarity “excluded” means model failing to advise is wrong and should be penalised. This is a relevant rubric and should be marked 1.
